# Third-party assets

Everything in this folder was downloaded from GitHub repositories on 2026-11-16 and is unchanged from the
source unless the row says otherwise. Each source folder holds the licence file copied from its repository.
"Origin" names the original publisher when the repository redistributes someone else's work.
Only the Oculus Audio Pack (CC BY 4.0) requires a credit; the SIL OFL font licence must travel with the font files.

## Checks made on 2026-11-16

- Every file is non-empty and has the magic bytes of its type; all 159 images decode; the 6 HDR headers parse
  (five 2048x1024, one 4096x2048); the 111 WAV files open; the 231 OGG files are Ogg Vorbis; the 4 fonts load
  and render Hangul; every glTF/GLB parses and its buffers and textures are present.
- SHA-256 matches the publisher's own list for 98 files from sample-assets (`manifest.json`), 231 from
  Meta-open-sound (`SHA256SUMS`), 56 of 57 from RobotNativeEngine (the one difference is the roller-shutter glTF
  that upstream edited after pinning its hash), and the Git LFS object id of the Matter-Library sky.
- Normal-map direction was measured against height / occlusion maps: everything named `NormalGL` or `nor_gl`
  here is OpenGL-style (ready for Unity); the two folders named in the table are DirectX-style.

## Looked at and left out

- ambientCG Concrete009 from FelicePollano/Boom: its `NormalGL` and `NormalDX` files are swapped upstream.
- itz019/tls-textures, assetfs/polyhaven-hdri, jasmine314-dev/dm-portal-assets, Igrium/polyhaven-models: they say their
  files are CC0 ambientCG / Poly Haven assets but have no licence file.
- `rooftop-night-2k.hdr` in linranff/GTA_SZ: MIT covers that repository's code only and its asset notices do not list this file.
- `rooftop_night_2k.hdr` in sceneview/sceneview (CC0, credited): really a 1024x512 downsample, too small for a sky.
- raisimTech/raisim2Lib street props (street lamp, utility box, trash can): the repository licence is proprietary and says `rsc/` files carry their own per-folder terms, which I did not trace.
- Blanket's rain, city and storm loops (CC BY) and its noise files (CC BY-SA): not needed, the Oculus pack covers rain and city.
- Poly Haven `concrete_road_barrier` (RobotNativeEngine, CC0): 60,928 triangles, too heavy for this game's low-poly look.
